name: PTFE Lining
summary: Advanced fluoropolymer PTFE lining solutions applied to pipes, fittings, vessels, and chemical columns to provide an impermeable, non-stick chemical barrier against aggressive acids and high temperatures.
meta_description: PTFE lining for corrosive, reactive, or ultra-pure media where chemical resistance and a smooth non-stick surface are required.
key_features: Complete chemical inertness against concentrated nitric, sulfuric, hydrochloric, and hydrofluoric acids up to 260°C
Thick-wall paste extruded PTFE liner prevents permeation and thermal vacuum collapse in continuous vacuum lines
Seamless flared-over sealing faces eliminate separate gaskets at pipe spool and vessel flange connections
Ultra-smooth non-stick surface coefficient prevents scaling, chemical fouling, and pressure drop in transfer lines
100% Non-destructive electro-spark tested (20kV+ DC) to guarantee zero pinholes or micro-cracks before dispatch
applications: Petrochemical acid wash columns, chlorine headers, and pickling acid recirculation loops
Agrochemical and fertilizer manufacturing acid feed lines
Pharmaceutical API synthesis reactors and high-purity solvent transfer lines
Power plant FGD (Flue Gas Desulfurization) chemical dosing and neutralization tanks
Palm oil oleochemical fatty acid distillation columns and chlor-alkali plants
materials: Liner Material: 100% Virgin PTFE, Conductive PTFE (Antistatic), PFA, FEP
Substrate Steel: Carbon Steel (A106 Gr B, A53), SS304, SS316L, ASTM A395 Ductile Iron fittings

content_html:
PTFE Lining

Heavy-duty fluoropolymer PTFE lining services engineered by PT Misuba Guna Indonesia for complete internal corrosion protection of carbon steel and alloy piping systems, columns, tanks, and chemical reactors. Using paste-extruded virgin PTFE, PFA, or FEP liners (thick-wall paste extruded or sheet lined), our linings form a seamless, non-stick barrier that resists extreme chemical attack from concentrated acids, strong alkalis, and reactive solvents.

Equipped with thermal paste-flaring technology and vacuum-resistant locking grooves, our lined pipe spools and fittings withstand severe thermal cycling without liner collapse, liner creep, or vacuum deformation.

Custom Engineering Consultation & Ordering Guide

When requesting a quote for PTFE lined pipe spools, vessels, or fittings, please specify line nominal size (DN15 to DN600), total spool lengths (OAL), flange drilling (ANSI 150#/300#, JIS 10K, DIN PN16), operating temperature, vacuum conditions, and specific chemical concentration. Our technical team conducts spark testing (15kV to 25kV) and hydrostatic verification on 100% of lined components prior to site delivery.
